Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, wbo As Object, ws As Worksheet, r As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set wbo = wb
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    r = "ok"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 1
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultPivotTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultPivotTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 2
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultSlicerStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultSlicerStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 3
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultTimelineStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultTimelineStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 4
        r = TypeName(wb.ShowPivotTableFieldList) & ":" & CStr(wb.ShowPivotTableFieldList)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 5
        r = TypeName(wb.ShowPivotChartActiveFields) & ":" & CStr(wb.ShowPivotChartActiveFields)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 6
        r = TypeName(wb.CreateBackup) & ":" & CStr(wb.CreateBackup)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 7
        r = TypeName(wb.InactiveListBorderVisible) & ":" & CStr(wb.InactiveListBorderVisible)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 8
        r = TypeName(wb.UpdateRemoteReferences) & ":" & CStr(wb.UpdateRemoteReferences)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 9
        r = TypeName(wb.ChartDataPointTrack) & ":" & CStr(wb.ChartDataPointTrack)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 10
        r = TypeName(wb.AccuracyVersion) & ":" & CStr(wb.AccuracyVersion)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 11
        r = TypeName(wb.Final) & ":" & CStr(wb.Final)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 12
        r = TypeName(wb.HasPassword) & ":" & CStr(wb.HasPassword)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 13
        r = TypeName(wb.CaseSensitive) & ":" & CStr(wb.CaseSensitive)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 14
        r = TypeName(wb.UseWholeCellCriteria) & ":" & CStr(wb.UseWholeCellCriteria)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 15
        r = TypeName(wb.UseWildcards) & ":" & CStr(wb.UseWildcards)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 16
        wbo.ShowPivotTableFieldList = Not wb.ShowPivotTableFieldList
        r = CStr(wb.ShowPivotTableFieldList)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ShowPivotTableFieldList.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 17
        wbo.ShowPivotTableFieldList = "x"
        r = CStr(wb.ShowPivotTableFieldList)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 18
        wbo.ShowPivotTableFieldList = 0
        r = CStr(wb.ShowPivotTableFieldList)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 19
        wbo.ShowPivotChartActiveFields = Not wb.ShowPivotChartActiveFields
        r = CStr(wb.ShowPivotChartActiveFields)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ShowPivotChartActiveFields.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 20
        wbo.ShowPivotChartActiveFields = "x"
        r = CStr(wb.ShowPivotChartActiveFields)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 21
        wbo.ShowPivotChartActiveFields = 0
        r = CStr(wb.ShowPivotChartActiveFields)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 22
        wbo.CreateBackup = Not wb.CreateBackup
        r = CStr(wb.CreateBackup)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\CreateBackup.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 23
        wbo.CreateBackup = "x"
        r = CStr(wb.CreateBackup)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 24
        wbo.CreateBackup = 0
        r = CStr(wb.CreateBackup)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 25
        wbo.InactiveListBorderVisible = Not wb.InactiveListBorderVisible
        r = CStr(wb.InactiveListBorderVisible)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\InactiveListBorderVisible.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 26
        wbo.InactiveListBorderVisible = "x"
        r = CStr(wb.InactiveListBorderVisible)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 27
        wbo.InactiveListBorderVisible = 0
        r = CStr(wb.InactiveListBorderVisible)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 28
        wbo.UpdateRemoteReferences = Not wb.UpdateRemoteReferences
        r = CStr(wb.UpdateRemoteReferences)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\UpdateRemoteReferences.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 29
        wbo.UpdateRemoteReferences = "x"
        r = CStr(wb.UpdateRemoteReferences)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 30
        wbo.UpdateRemoteReferences = 0
        r = CStr(wb.UpdateRemoteReferences)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 31
        wbo.ChartDataPointTrack = Not wb.ChartDataPointTrack
        r = CStr(wb.ChartDataPointTrack)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ChartDataPointTrack.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 32
        wbo.ChartDataPointTrack = "x"
        r = CStr(wb.ChartDataPointTrack)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 33
        wbo.ChartDataPointTrack = 0
        r = CStr(wb.ChartDataPointTrack)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 34
        wbo.CaseSensitive = Not wb.CaseSensitive
        r = CStr(wb.CaseSensitive)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\CaseSensitive.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 35
        wbo.CaseSensitive = "x"
        r = CStr(wb.CaseSensitive)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 36
        wbo.CaseSensitive = 0
        r = CStr(wb.CaseSensitive)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 37
        wbo.UseWholeCellCriteria = Not wb.UseWholeCellCriteria
        r = CStr(wb.UseWholeCellCriteria)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\UseWholeCellCriteria.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 38
        wbo.UseWholeCellCriteria = "x"
        r = CStr(wb.UseWholeCellCriteria)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 39
        wbo.UseWholeCellCriteria = 0
        r = CStr(wb.UseWholeCellCriteria)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 40
        wbo.UseWildcards = Not wb.UseWildcards
        r = CStr(wb.UseWildcards)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\UseWildcards.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 41
        wbo.UseWildcards = "x"
        r = CStr(wb.UseWildcards)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 42
        wbo.UseWildcards = 0
        r = CStr(wb.UseWildcards)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 43
        wbo.DefaultTableStyle = "TableStyleMedium9"
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultTableStyle_TableStyleMedium9.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 44
        wbo.DefaultTableStyle = "tablestylelight1"
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultTableStyle_tablestylelight1.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 45
        wbo.DefaultTableStyle = "NoSuch"
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultTableStyle_NoSuch.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 46
        wbo.DefaultTableStyle = ""
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultTableStyle_blank.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 47
        wbo.DefaultTableStyle = wb.TableStyles("TableStyleDark1")
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultTableStyle_wbTableStylesTableStyleDark1.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 48
        wbo.DefaultTableStyle = 5
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultTableStyle_5.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 49
        wbo.DefaultPivotTableStyle = "PivotStyleMedium2"
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultPivotTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultPivotTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultPivotTableStyle_PivotStyleMedium2.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 50
        wbo.DefaultPivotTableStyle = "NoSuch"
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultPivotTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultPivotTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultPivotTableStyle_NoSuch.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 51
        wbo.DefaultPivotTableStyle = ""
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultPivotTableStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultPivotTableStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultPivotTableStyle_blank.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 52
        wbo.DefaultSlicerStyle = "SlicerStyleDark1"
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultSlicerStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultSlicerStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultSlicerStyle_SlicerStyleDark1.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 53
        wbo.DefaultSlicerStyle = "NoSuch"
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultSlicerStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultSlicerStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultSlicerStyle_NoSuch.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 54
        wbo.DefaultTimelineStyle = "TimeSlicerStyleDark1"
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultTimelineStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultTimelineStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultTimelineStyle_TimeSlicerStyleDark1.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 55
        wbo.DefaultTimelineStyle = "NoSuch"
        r = TypeName(wb.DefaultTimelineStyle) & ":" & CStr(wb.DefaultTimelineStyle)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\DefaultTimelineStyle_NoSuch.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 56
        wbo.DefaultTableStyle = "TableStyleLight1"
        ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B3"), , xlYes).Name = "T"
        r = ws.ListObjects(1).TableStyle
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 57
        wbo.AccuracyVersion = 1
        r = CStr(wb.AccuracyVersion)
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\AccuracyVersion.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 58
        wbo.AccuracyVersion = 2
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 59
        wbo.HasPassword = True
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 60
        wbo.Password = "a"
        r = CStr(wb.HasPassword)
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 61
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("ab", "AB", "a*"))
        wbo.CaseSensitive = True
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=COUNTIF(A1:A3,""ab"")"
        r = ws.Range("B1").Value
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 62
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("ab", "AB", "a*"))
        wbo.UseWildcards = False
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=COUNTIF(A1:A3,""a*"")"
        r = ws.Range("B1").Value
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 63
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("ab", "abc", "a"))
        wbo.UseWholeCellCriteria = False
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=COUNTIF(A1:A3,""a"")"
        r = ws.Range("B1").Value
        Tried = CStr(r)
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
